title: 控制台偏好写入等首读返回，不再单独补查一次
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX11yNi4DyGhuzqBpV

Filing gate: ① regression found by a cloud gate. Source: cloud `console-boots` call budget (cloud#2914) on pin PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4975 (card objectstack-ai/cloud#4974, p1), job 138720631611: page/pricing 26 calls against 25, 0 duplicate URLs; trace on that PR. Dedupe: searched open issues for `ui.recent` / preference save race, none.

Grading: area:cloud (it blocks the p1 cloud pin round's `console-boots`, maintainer rule 2026-11-24 03:50Z) · Bug · p1 (blocks a p1) · evidence: measured (CI call list) + read (code path below).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：控制台打开页面时，会先一次性读出用户的偏好（最近访问、收藏等）。如果这次读还没返回、页面就要记录「最近访问」，就会再单独查一次自己的那条记录，多一次请求。
- 影响：功能正常；慢环境下每次打开多一次请求，云端的启动请求预算因此时红时绿。
- 修法：写入先等这次读返回，直接用读到的记录去更新。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/userState.ts`, `createObjectStackUserStateAdapter`: `load()` joins the shared preference read (one request for every slot, objectui#12187) and calls `writer.remember(row.id)` when it answers. `save()` chains `writer.upsert(items)` onto `saveChain` only. When a save runs before the load has answered (the recents flush is debounced 500 ms after the page records itself, `RecentItemsProvider`), `cachedRowId` is still null and `upsert` sends `findExisting()`, the per-key read `sys_user_preference?$top=1&key=<key>`, although the shared read is about to return the same row.

CI call list (cloud PR #4975, warm open of page/pricing): the shared read `sys_user_preference?top=204` (with `ui.recent` in its `$in`) at position 11, then `sys_user_preference?top=1&key=ui.recent` at 19, then `PATCH sys_user_preference/<id>`.

## Change

A save waits for the adapter's in-flight load (if any) before it upserts, so the remembered row id is used. A failed or absent load leaves today's behaviour (find, then update or create). Same for the key-family writer if it has the same shape.

## Acceptance

- Unit test: a save issued while the load is pending sends no per-key read and updates the row the load returned; ablation (remove the wait) goes red.
- Existing upsert behaviours unchanged: no row → create; UNIQUE race → re-find + update; concurrent saves still serialize.
- Not in scope: the debounce, the recents provider, or the call budget number.
